faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything You Need to Know
faq.description: Got questions? We've got answers. If you can't find what you're looking for, please contact our support team.
faq.q_pricing: How much does SIGMACODE AI cost? (Pricing & Plans)
faq.a_pricing: We offer flexible pricing for startups and enterprises. Choose between transparent usage-based billing and fixed enterprise plans with SLAs. Contact sales for a tailored quote.
faq.q_trial: Do you offer a free trial?
faq.a_trial: Yes, start with a free trial to evaluate core features, model quality, and integrations. You can upgrade anytime without data loss.
faq.q_security: Is my data secure? (Security, Privacy & GDPR)
faq.a_security: We follow industry best practices: encryption at rest/in transit, role-based access, audit logs, and data minimization. We support GDPR and provide EU-only processing on request.
faq.q_deployment: Can I deploy on-premises or in my VPC?
faq.a_deployment: Yes. Deploy fully managed in the cloud or self-host in your VPC/on-prem. Hybrid setups with private networking and custom KMS are supported.
faq.a_integrations: Native connectors for popular stacks (GitHub, Slack, Notion, Jira), webhooks, and a clean REST/GraphQL API. SDKs for TypeScript and Python.
faq.q_customization: Can I customize and fine-tune models?
faq.a_customization: Absolutely. Add domain knowledge, retrieval, guardrails, and fine-tune models for tone, structure, and compliance. Versioning and A/B testing included.
faq.q_accuracy: How accurate are the results? (Quality & Evaluation)
faq.a_accuracy: We provide evaluation suites, benchmarks, and human-in-the-loop review. You can track precision/recall, latency, and cost per task in the dashboard.
faq.q_compliance: Which compliance standards do you support?
faq.a_compliance: GDPR-ready by design; SOC 2 and ISO 27001 processes aligned. Data residency and DPA are available for enterprise customers.
faq.q_models: Which models and languages are supported?
faq.a_models: We support leading foundation models and multi-lingual use cases. You can bring your own model and switch providers without rewriting code.
faq.q_sla: What support options and SLAs are available?
faq.a_sla: From community support to dedicated success managers and 99.9% uptime SLAs. Priority incident response for enterprise plans.
faq.q_cancellation: Can I cancel anytime? Who owns the data?
faq.a_cancellation: You can cancel anytime. You retain full ownership of your data and can export projects securely before closing the account.
